name: 小黄鸡 3L 带内衬滑雪套装
description:
黄色小鸡造型滑雪服：帽子上有立体鸡冠和一对大眼睛，袖口挂着橙色小鸡爪，配橙色阔腿雪裤，整套在雪场上非常吸睛。这是带内衬的保暖版，冷天也能穿。帽子上的眼睛是品牌盲盒配饰（共 7 款），以实物为准。尺码 M。

## 面料与科技
- 3L 三层复合硬壳面料，带保暖内衬
- 防水指数 20000mmH₂O（GB/T 4744-2013）
- 透湿量 10320 g/m²·24h（GB/T 12704.2-2009）

## 设计细节
- 全身 YEACCO 单手调节扣，戴着手套也能单手收紧
- 立体鸡冠、大眼睛帽子，袖口小鸡爪装饰
- 雪裤魔术贴调节腰围，调节范围大，适合各种身形
- 雪裤内置弹力雪裙，防风防雪
- 宽松阔腿版型，单板、双板都合适

## 尺码（M）
- 上衣：胸围 126cm、衣长 77cm、肩袖长 79cm（170/88A）
- 雪裤：裤长 108.5cm、腰围 100cm、臀围 144cm（170/72A）
descriptionEn:
A yellow chick snow suit: the hood has a 3D comb and a pair of big googly eyes, little orange chick feet hang from the cuffs, and it comes with wide orange snow pants. Impossible to miss on the slopes. This is the insulated version, warm enough for cold days. The eyes on the hood are the brand's blind-box accessory (7 styles), so yours may look different from the photos. Size M.

## Fabric & Technology
- 3-layer hardshell fabric with an insulated lining
- Waterproof rating 20,000 mmH₂O (GB/T 4744-2013)
- Breathability 10,320 g/m²·24h (GB/T 12704.2-2009)

## Design Details
- YEACCO one-hand adjusters throughout — tighten them even with gloves on
- Hood with a 3D comb and big eyes; chick-feet trims on the cuffs
- Hook-and-loop waist adjusters on the pants with a wide range to fit different body types
- Built-in elastic snow gaiter in the pants keeps wind and snow out
- Relaxed wide-leg fit — great for snowboarding or skiing

## Size (M)
- Jacket: chest 126 cm, length 77 cm, shoulder-to-cuff 79 cm (170/88A)
- Pants: length 108.5 cm, waist 100 cm, hips 144 cm (170/72A)

- 耐磨 ＞200000 次（实测）

descriptionEn:
A black Doberman snow suit: the hood has a pair of pointy upright ears and brown embroidered bone details, with caramel suede-look panels and two brown front zippers. The brown side panels on the pants echo a Doberman's markings. Size M.

## Fabric & Tech

- Waterproof rating 20,000 mmH₂O (GB/T 4744-2013)

name: 小帝企鹅 3L 带衬滑雪上衣
nameEn: Little Emperor Penguin 3L Insulated Ski Jacket
description:
帽子做成了小企鹅的脸，橙色小嘴巴，袖口挂着橙色小企鹅脚。黑白配色，胸前一道橙色拉链。这是带内衬的保暖款。这款只有上衣。下单时可以选“加一条黑色滑雪裤”（款式随机，按套装价），也可以去 Mix & Match 自己搭一条雪裤。尺码 M。

## 面料与科技
- 3L 三层复合面料
- 防水指数 20000mmH₂O（GB/T 4744-2013）
- 透湿量 10320 g/m²·24h（GB/T 12704.2-2009）
- 面料 100% 锦纶；里料 100% 锦纶 / 100% 聚酯纤维；填充 100% 聚酯纤维

## 尺码（M，170/88A）
- 胸围 127cm、肩袖长 79cm、衣长 76cm
descriptionEn:
The hood is a little penguin face with an orange beak, and orange penguin feet hang from the cuffs. Black and white with an orange zipper down the front. This is the insulated version. This is the jacket only. When you book, you can choose “Add black snow pants” (style may vary, charged at the set price), or pair your own pants in Mix & Match. Size M.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3-layer laminated fabric
- Waterproof rating 20,000 mmH₂O (GB/T 4744-2013)
- Breathability 10,320 g/m²/24h (GB/T 12704.2-2009)
- Shell 100% nylon; lining 100% nylon / 100% polyester; fill 100% polyester

## Size (M, 170/88A)
- Chest 127 cm, shoulder-to-cuff 79 cm, length 76 cm
